title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
text: We present InstructGPT, a method for aligning language models with user intent through fine-tuning with human feedback. Our results show that InstructGPT models are preferred over GPT-3 despite having 100x fewer parameters, with improvements in truthfulness and reductions in toxic output generation.
text_summary: InstructGPT aligns LLMs with human intent via RLHF fine-tuning, outperforming larger models.
